scope: 5 worlds × 2 spaces × 3 conditional programs; sampled/lower/upper bounded candidates + 4 known formal-selector regression seeds; full production v2 admission
limitations: Finite machine qualification only. Not all legal seeds, not natural play or visual approval. Fallback candidates always run admission. Boundary snapshots test CSV endpoints, not separate approved runtime recipes.
sourceScope: Generation and condition contracts; visual drawing modules are separately reviewed and excluded from this non-rendering qualification.

rejected.reason: Semantic deployment: initial and 12 bounded encounter seats rejected; Semantic deployment: no longer, materially lower-exposure route
